construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation authored for this isolated build

shared_schema.profile: experience: novice|intermediate|expert; preference: brief|detailed; topic: nonempty searchable text; completed: unique known step IDs respecting prerequisites
shared_schema.fixtures: Canonical URL keys map to unique fixture_id, title and text. Every requested source must have exactly one synthetic fixture.
shared_schema.findings: score, exact quote, zero-based start/end Unicode character offsets, canonical url, title, fixture_id, synthetic=true
shared_schema.validation: validate(stage,value) handles input, onboarding handoff and final output. Unknown/missing fields are rejected. CLI errors emit one JSON error object with exit code 2.

cross_stage_handoffs: Adaptive onboarding validates input and produces a prerequisite-ordered plan with experience credits and preference-specific explanations.
Its validated output carries the normalized query, preference and complete canonicalized retrieval configuration including synthetic fixtures.
Web research accepts only the onboarding output, revalidates it through the shared layer, then ingests and retrieves its exact allowlisted sources.
Final validation checks query/source lineage and recomputes evidence to verify provenance.

behavior.onboarding: Novices receive basics, source_evaluation and research. Intermediate users receive basics credit; experts also receive source_evaluation credit. Explicit completed steps are honored. Ready denotes a complete actionable plan, not proof that a human completed training.
behavior.url_policy: HTTPS only, exact allowlisted DNS host, no IP literals, credentials, explicit ports, fragments, whitespace or backslashes. Canonicalization lowercases hosts and normalizes an empty path to slash. Queries are preserved; subdomains require separate allowlisting.
behavior.retrieval: Offline fixture ingestion only; no HTTP requests. ASCII alphanumeric case-insensitive query tokens score exact-token overlap in sentence passages. Ties use source order then character offset. Brief returns at most one passage per source; detailed considers all matching passages, bounded by max_results.
behavior.empty_results: Successful result with an empty findings list and all nonmatching sources reported.
behavior.determinism: No randomness, clock inputs, providers or mutable global state. Input is not modified.

excluded: Verification of fixture claims against the real world

test_outcomes.cli: Passed: example emits one JSON object with status ok and exits 0; missing files, malformed JSON, invalid schemas and usage errors emit status error and exit 2.
